name: @waste/worker
description: The pg-boss worker (ADR-0007): the second Node process on the database, on which the jobs the contexts owe run. `src/runtime/` is the process's core — pg-boss booted on the worker role's session connection with `migrate: false` (the owner installed schema `pgboss` in migration 0011), each job given its queue, its worker and, where it recurs, its cron schedule, and the outbox seam and relay; each context's jobs and readers live in `src/<context>/`, and `src/jobs.ts` lists every job the process runs. GET /healthz (liveness) and GET /readyz (readiness) answer on its own port for the host's probe.
